N two-level bridges in series on the dc

Vdc,k ≈ Vdc/N: the device voltage class
follows the cell, not the full link.
All cells carry the same dc current; Pac
= ΣPk, so cell voltages must be
balanced actively.
6N switches, N drivers and capacitors:
complexity moves to the system, it
does not vanish.
